headline: Blue Camp Says Officials Knew but Didn't Report, Must Be Held Accountable; Ministry of Economic Affairs: Taisugar Conducts High-Standard Self-Inspection | Politics
summary: The KMT caucus said officials at Taiwan Sugar who allegedly knew Zhonglian oils and fats exceeded benzo[a]pyrene standards in advance should be held accountable. The Ministry of Economic Affairs says Taisugar is conducting a self-inspection.
why: Taiwan Sugar is a state-owned food and industrial company, and contamination issues in edible oils can affect supply chains and consumer confidence.
